needed.evidence: The footway is an informal path blocked by market stalls and goods.
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built, continuous sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: Market stalls and produce are blocking the pedestrian area.
needed.suggestion: Relocate market stalls to a designated vending area to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: The informal path is uneven and obstructed by goods.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the pedestrian area on the right side to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: High pedestrian demand due to shops on both sides, but no designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide a safe point for pedestrians to cross the road.

needed.evidence: Urban commercial street with no visible street lighting infrastructure.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety at night.
